entries.rationale: External toolchain/network boundary: a real from-source install clones the repository from GitHub and compiles cass with a rustup-installed pinned toolchain. Scripted git/rustup/cargo executables on PATH record their invocation order, so source_install_bootstraps_the_toolchain_after_clone proves install.sh installs the pinned toolchain after the clone and before the build, without network access or a toolchain build. install.sh itself runs unchanged.
